items.hed: New Astros general manager Randy Flores said hiring Brad Ausmus as manager was his own call, pushing back on questions about how much authority he actually holds in Houston's front office
items.insight: Flores, a week into the job after being hired Oct. 30, told reporters in Las Vegas that owner Jim Crane told him "It's your decision" on the Ausmus hire, which followed a four-hour meeting between the two men in San Diego, according to The Athletic. The hire has drawn scrutiny because Ausmus is close with senior adviser Jeff Bagwell, a former Houston teammate whose influence in the front office has grown, and because Crane had previously courted Ausmus for the manager job in 2020 and the GM job in 2022. "Right now, I have a week on the job where I feel like [Bagwell] is an adviser. I feel like I'm making decisions," Flores said, adding that he can't fight perceptions built up over the organization's recent history.

items.hed: Alperen Sengun scored 43 points and grabbed 12 rebounds as the Rockets held off Utah 125-118 Friday night at Toyota Center, handing the Jazz their 11th straight loss and improving Houston to 9-3
items.insight: The win came in NBA Cup group-play, with Sengun posting a career-high scoring night alongside Fred VanVleet and Amen Thompson in the rotation, according to the league's official game page. Utah has now lost 11 in a row and remains well under .500 on the season.
